<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21012025-03-3113-44-56" status="finalized">'dir <rs type="person" ref="db:3807" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">'bre</rs> na re rnam pa'i don ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la 
<!--image 44--><pb n="26b"/><lb edRef="inst:4622" n="26b1"/> skyes pa mkhyen <note type="gloss">pa</note> gsum gyi bye brag yin la | de yang <note type="gloss">rang</note> gi rgyud la yod pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang tha mi dad par goms par byed pa la brjod de | 'bras bu'i theg pa gsum lam du byed pa yin pas pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa ni gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no || gal te de lta na so so'i skye bo la yang zag med kyi ye shes yod par 'gyur ro zhe na | 'dod pa yin te <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">rgyud bla ma</rs> las | <quote>dar <lb edRef="inst:4622" n="26b2"/> yug chen po'i dpes byis pa so so'i skye bo la yang sangs rgyas kyi yod tan ma tshang pa med par</quote> gsungs pa'i phyir la | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6531">sdud pa'i 'grel pa</rs> las kyang | <quote>dri ma med pa yid la rten pa</quote> zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro || sbyor pa ni gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa skye med du sgom pa mkhyen pa gsum gyi sbyor ba yin no zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
source: 1_021_01_ gZhon nu rin chen_mngon par rtog pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel ba bcud kyi thig le.xml
